does: Reads the profile's modsettings.lsx: joins the profile folder (from the object at +0x208, slot +0x68) with modsettings.lsx and loads it into the ls::ModuleSettings at +0x1C0; called by code:ecl::EocClient::Load with the client's mod manager (EocClient +0x140) right after Load queues its first states.

evidence.says: dx11 body builds the path from the text modsettings.lsx and the profile folder, as the Toolkit's EoCClient.dll ecl::ModManagerClient::LoadModSettingsFile (path + ls::ModuleSettings::LoadSettings at +0x1C0); code:ecl::EocClient::Load calls it right after its first GameStateMachine::SetTargetState (InitMenu) and a call of bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x1C3FCF0, only when neither +0x40 nor +0x41 of the global at bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x5F9DEA0 is set, as the Toolkit's Load calls LoadModSettingsFile
The macOS build's symbols hold this name; nothing but the name ties it to this function
